dedupe_keys.name: erigrid 2 0 power to heat case study laboratories in five countries linked by the jander middleware

description: This case study from the H2020 ERIGrid 2.0 project links research laboratories in Denmark, Greece, Italy, the Netherlands and Norway into one real-time experiment on power-to-heat services in a local multi-energy district. The authors deployed the JaNDER middleware and its universal API to provide high-data-rate, low-latency communication between the laboratories and used geographically distributed simulation with hardware-in-the-loop to analyse the effect of heat pumps and similar services on electrical and thermal networks under several operating scenarios. Coverage is a virtual district built from five sites. Format and access: an arXiv preprint under the arXiv distribution licence; free to read; the abstract does not state whether code or data are released. Caveats: it is a testbed demonstration, not an operating system, and it does not say whether the software is open. It supports resilience and flexibility studies of coupled power and heat operation. Related catalogue records are the ERIGrid 2.0 benchmark electrical network and the DHNSim pandapipes model.
